cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Join Me
cards.instruction: Recruit someone into a secret plan.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've selected you to distract Mum while I hide her birthday cake. You may accept.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can I be the one who brings it in this year?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That honour is approved. First ask her to show you her pastry trick; I need twenty minutes.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She'll make me bake a whole pie.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Once the cake is hidden, I'll join you to peel the apples. You may regard that as a special concession. Are you in?

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 offers selection, A3 grants the cake-bearing honor, and A5 presents useful help as a superior concession to recruit B.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 role request is granted by A3; B4 pie burden causes A5 future participation after concealment, with the sequence now explicit.

relationship.evidence: B2 wants a valued family role and B4 objects to real work; A5 responds with a practical concession rather than dismissing B.

heightening.evidence: B4 expands a diversion into baking; A5 commits personal labor while retaining the superior manner.

specificity.evidence: A1 Mum birthday concealment and A3 twenty-minute pastry diversion communicate roles and stakes without outside history.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 special-concession wording attached to peeling apples exposes the character without mocking the sincere secret plan.
